By records: imported exactly 1460, with caveats 517, not imported 1425 (of 3402).

Caveats (cards may carry several), with their direction: does the term allow outcomes the printed card does not (allows more), forbid outcomes it allows (forbids some), or both? A card imported with caveats is in general neither an over- nor an under-approximation of its printed card, so the imported pool must not be used for "no deck can ..." arguments without checking the caveat.

| caveat | direction | cards | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upTo0` | allows more | 27 | 'up to N' in a Trainer or an Ability allows 0 in the model; the rulebook asks for at least 1 outside attacks (2026 rulebook p. 21; Known gaps, zone moves item) |
| `noopUse` | allows more | 20 | an Ability whose effect may do nothing in the model (a switch with an empty Bench, a heal of an undamaged Pokémon, a move of Energy that moves none, a take when there is nothing to take, a condition tested when the effect resolves) can be used to no effect, marking its Pokémon as used; whether the printed game allows such a use was not checked |
| `aceSpec` | allows more | 15 | the ACE SPEC deck-building limit is not modelled (no deck construction in the model) |
| `mayFail` | allows more | 15 | an attach or Bench placement may do nothing in the model (`attach` and `putBench` always allow nothing), a superset of the printed 'attach a …' from the hand or discard pile, and of 'if you can' (Known gaps) |
| `moveAnyPair` | allows more | 8 | a move of Energy printed between particular Pokémon ('to this Pokémon', 'from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon') is a move between any two of the player's Pokémon (moveEnergy) |
| `noopPlay` | allows more | 8 | a Trainer whose effect may do nothing in the model (switch with an empty Bench, heal an undamaged Pokémon, cure a Pokémon with no Special Condition) can be played to no effect; a Trainer cannot be played when its effect cannot happen (taken from rulings, not in the 2023 rulebook on hand) |
| `moveMayFail` | allows more | 7 | a move of Energy is `moveEnergy`, which may move nothing (`moveNone`; Known gaps, zone moves item: 'attach, putBench and moveEnergy may always do nothing, a superset of "if you can"'), where print moves one Energy if one can be moved |
| `searchAny` | allows more | 7 | a deck search for 'a card' (any card) may find nothing in the model |
| `hiddenInfo` | allows more | 6 | a sentence that only reveals or looks at cards is a no-op (hidden information is not modelled, Known gaps) |
| `onePerName` | allows more | 3 | 'You can't use more than 1 X Ability each turn' is not modelled: the use flag is per Pokémon, so each of several Pokémon with that Ability can use it in the same turn |
| `selfBench` | allows more | 3 | 'this Pokémon' on the Bench is one Benched Pokémon chosen when the effect resolves, and for an on-play Ability the Active Pokémon or a Benched one (Known gaps, M8a: SelfOp.at) |
| `trigKO` | allows more | 3 | 'is Knocked Out by damage from an attack' is read as 'Knocked Out by a Knock Out check while the turn's attack has been made': Knock Outs by damage counters the attack placed, by later rounds of the check, and in the check after a failed Confused attempt also fire it (Known gaps, triggered Abilities, M8b) |
| `koCheckup` | forbids some | 4 | 'Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn' (any cause) is `Count.koLast w false`, and the model records Knock Outs at Pokémon Checkup in no turn (Known gaps, one-turn history, milestone MV2): a Knock Out by Poison or Burn after the opponent's turn does not make the test true; whether the printed condition counts it was not checked against a ruling |
| `anyAmount60` | forbids some | 3 | 'discard any amount / all … for each card you discarded in this way' is `forUpTo` with the bound 60, the cards of a legal deck (2026 rulebook p. 21): exact for every state in which the player has at most 60 cards that could be discarded (`Run.forUpTo_complete`, `discardActive_le`); the model does not require this of a start state, and beyond it a larger discard is forbidden (Known gaps, zone moves item: 'exact once the bound covers the cards that can be taken'); for 'discard all' with more than 60 the attack has no resolution |
| `movedUpPromotion` | forbids some | 3 | 'moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn' is `InPlay.movedUp`, which a promotion after a Knock Out of the player's own Active Pokémon in their own turn does not set (Known gaps, one-turn history, milestone MV2: an under-model) |
| `perPokemon` | both | 92 | a lingering effect printed on one Pokémon ('this Pokémon', 'the Defending Pokémon') is a modifier of its player in the model (Known gaps: modifiers belong to a player) |
| `benchMods` | both | 67 | attack damage to Benched Pokémon takes no bonus, reduction or prevention in the model (Known gaps, milestone M3) |
| `recoil` | both | 66 | self-damage ('also does N damage to itself') is written as damage counters (selfDamage): no Weakness, Resistance or modifier applies to it (Known gaps) |
| `staticBench` | both | 16 | a static damage reduction ('takes N less damage from attacks') is subtracted at step 5 of the damage calculation, which only damage to the Active Pokémon passes through: attack damage to a Benched Pokémon takes no reduction in the model (Known gaps, milestone M3: Bench damage takes no bonus, reduction or prevention; milestone M6) |
| `trigAttacker` | both | 14 | 'the Attacking Pokémon' is the opponent's Active Pokémon when the trigger resolves: if the attack switched its attacker out ('damaged'), or the attacker was Knocked Out by the same check ('Knocked Out'), the effect falls on the new Active Pokémon instead of the attacker or nothing (Known gaps, triggered Abilities, M8b) |
| `trigDamaged` | both | 14 | 'is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack' is decided on the attack's damage step (HitRun, HitTrig): a Pokémon damaged and then switched to the Bench by the same attack fires nothing, and when the Defending Pokémon was already at or above its HP before the damage step the trigger may fire or not (Known gaps, triggered Abilities, M8b: the two departures, one in each direction) |
| `ignFxStadium` | both | 11 | 'isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon' (`Ign.fx`, milestone MV3) switches off step 5 of the damage calculation, which in the model includes the reductions and preventions a Stadium gives the defender (Known gaps, Weakness and Resistance item: `Ign`, step 5); whether the printed text ignores a Stadium's effect was not checked against a ruling |
| `koAttackWide` | both | 7 | 'Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn' is read as 'Knocked Out by the Knock Out check after the turn's attack' (`Count.koLast w true`): Knock Outs by damage counters an attack's effect placed also count (Known gaps, one-turn history, milestone MV2) |
| `staticPreventBench` | both | 5 | a static prevention ('Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's F', `SEff.prevent`, milestone MV3) protects the Pokémon only in the Active Spot: attack damage to a Benched Pokémon reads no static effect in the model (Known gaps, milestone M3: Bench damage takes no bonus, reduction or prevention; `GameState.sPrevent` is read at step 5, for the Active Pokémon) |
| `abilityByTool` | both | 3 | 'Pokémon that have an Ability' is `Filter.hasAbility`, which reads the printed Abilities and ignores an Ability a Tool gives in the model (Known gaps, filters: whether print counts a Tool's effect as the Pokémon's Ability is not settled); if it does, a Pokémon whose Ability comes from a Tool is not counted where print counts it, and an attacker with such an Ability is not prevented where print prevents its damage |
| `poisonStrength` | both | 1 | a stronger Poison ('N damage counters instead of 1') is written as Poison plus poisonUp (N-1); the Known gaps list numbered Poison variants as absent |

Stacking texts ("The effect of X doesn't stack", "You can't apply more than 1 … at a time") in static Abilities: 6, all refused. The model adds every static effect in force, so two Pokémon with the Ability give twice the amount, where the printed card gives it once: a different HP, damage or reduction, which changes outcomes in both directions (more HP lets a Pokémon survive what the printed card Knocks Out, and a larger bonus Knocks Out what the printed card leaves standing), so the term would not be an over-approximation and an "allows more" caveat would be false. Pokémon Tools and Stadiums in the pool print no stacking text (a player has one Stadium in play; one Tool per Pokémon).

- Bouffalant (svp-136): "As long as you have at least 1 other Bouffalant in play, all of your Basic Colorless Pokémon take 60 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Curly Wall doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest is refused too (cond).
- Ludicolo (sv9-37): "All of your Pokémon in play get +40 HP. The effect of Vibrant Dance doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest translates.
- Hop's Snorlax (sv9-117): "Attacks used by your Hop's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Extra Helpings doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest is refused too (filter).
- Steven's Carbink (sv10-86): "As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, all of your Steven's Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Stone Palace doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest is refused too (filter).
- Meganium (me1-10): "Each Basic Grass Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest is refused too (cost).
- Aurorus (me3-24): "All of your Pokémon that have any Water Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack." Refused; without the stacking sentence the rest translates.
